(def swap-vals!
  "Atomically swaps the value of atom to be:
  (apply f current-value-of-atom args). Note that f may be called
  multiple times, and thus should be free of side effects.
  Returns [old new], the value of the atom before and after the swap."
  (fn
    ([a f]
     (if (instance? Atom a)
       ;; As Clojure's Atom.swap: apply f to the value read, validate, and set
       ;; only if the atom is unchanged; if f changed it, run f again.
       (loop []
         (let [v (.-state a)
               newv (f v)
               validate (.-validator a)]
           (when-not (suss.bootstrap/nil? validate)
             (when-not (validate newv)
               (throw (suss.bootstrap/error "Invalid reference state"))))
           (if (atom-unchanged? (.-state a) v)
             (do (set! (.-state a) newv)
                 (when-not (suss.bootstrap/nil? (.-watches a))
                   (-notify-watches a v newv))
                 [v newv])
             (recur))))
       [(-deref a) (-swap! a f)]))
    ([a f x]
     (if (instance? Atom a)
       (swap-vals! a (fn [v] (f v x)))
       [(-deref a) (-swap! a f x)]))
    ([a f x y]
     (if (instance? Atom a)
       (swap-vals! a (fn [v] (f v x y)))
       [(-deref a) (-swap! a f x y)]))
    ([a f x y & more]
     (if (instance? Atom a)
       (swap-vals! a (fn [v] (apply f v x y more)))
       [(-deref a) (-swap! a f x y more)]))))
